results.title: Anaya Bangar Answers Marizanne Kapp In 'Unfair Advantage' Row: 'Not All Trans Women...' - EXCLUSIVE
results.description: Anaya Bangar views Cricket Australia's decision to allow her to return to competitive cricket as a significant milestone. She is focused on self-acceptance and believes that opportunities should be merit-based, countering claims of unfair advantages in sports for transgender athletes.
